title: 第10章  不用你杀妖，功绩照领
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
陆渊来到书吏面前，将卷宗放在柜面上。
“劳烦刘书吏登记一下，赤霞县的差事我接了。”
老刘面无表情地对着陆渊打量一番，微微摇头。
“刚入门的新人？这差事，你接不了。”
陆渊将腰牌往柜面一放，“我是镇魔校尉。”
老刘神色一惊，下意识看了一眼腰牌，随即面露笑容躬身一礼。
“原来是陆大人当面，请恕卑职眼拙。”
“无妨，登记吧。”
“陆大人见谅，即便您是校尉，这差事您也接不了。”
陆渊一愣，连镇魔校尉都接不了？
老刘笑着解释道：“按规矩，新人第一次外出办差至少要有一名镇魔卫同行，以防出了岔子没人兜底。”
“陆大人入门即是镇魔校尉，可说到底也还是新人，这规矩不能坏。”
陆渊眉头微皱，要有镇魔卫同行？
他一开始就打算独自吃下那些血妖的。
正想着，他注意到了身后的苏定安。
这不就有个现成的吗！
“苏老哥，要不你随我去一趟赤霞县？”
“啊？我？”
苏定安的笑容僵硬了一瞬，张了张嘴，半天没说出话来。
那双晶亮的眸子中闪过几分复杂，有意外，有惊喜，还夹杂着几分心虚。

“那个......陆大人......我......”
苏定安低下了头，声音也小了几分。
“我要是被妖魔所杀，家中那痴傻老母就没人照顾，还有体弱多病的婆娘以及蹒跚学步的儿子......”
陆渊张了张嘴，还是沉默了。
就在这时，旁边突然传来一连串脚步声。
“苏定安，可算是找到你了。”
一个身穿墨黑锦袍的衙役从门外探进来半个身子。
“你老娘托我给你带句话，你也老大不小了，今年若是再谈不下媳妇儿，过年就别回家了。”
空气突然安静。
苏定安表情僵硬，站在原地不知所措。
陆渊眼神玩味，“你也不容易啊，有妻有儿，还要被老母催婚？”
“那个......”苏定安挤出一个比哭还难看的笑容，“所以说家中有个痴傻老母......”
良久，他一声长叹，把头埋了下去。
“陆大人......我就是......就是......怕死。”
“其实我也想斩妖除魔来着，可我资质太差，入门七年才从衙役晋升镇魔卫。”
“一没本事，二没胆量，到现在连一部像样的武学都没练成。”
“平时翻翻卷宗，靠着小聪明赚点儿碎银还行，若真是遇到妖魔，只怕第一个死的就是我。”
“算了陆大人，感谢您给我这个机会，我是真没那个本事。”
陆渊点头，忽然觉得苏定安这个人比他想象的要有意思得多。
而且，苏定安怕死，正好不用担心对方抢他的妖魔。

匹配成功！
“跟我去，不用你杀妖，功绩照领。”陆渊开口。
“啊？”苏定安猛地抬头，都以为自己听错了。
不用杀妖？
那不是让他白赚功绩？
那卷宗上写得分明，一旦斩杀血妖，主办可拿二十点功绩，十两银子，协办可拿十点功绩，五两银子。
若能将血妖元凶捉回镇魔司，每人还可以再加五点功绩，三两银子。
这......白送？
苏定安一时间有些口干舌燥。
陆渊继续开口：“到了赤霞县，你负责带路，指认，摸查具体情况。”
“若真遇到妖魔，你找个安全的地方躲远点，等我杀完了再出来。”
“这......”苏定安嘴角有些压不住了，“陆大人是说笑吧？”
看到陆渊一脸正色，不像玩笑，他心底不由生出几分心动。
“真不用我动手？”苏定安试探问道。
“不用。”
“那我可否躲远点？”
“越远越好。”
“嘶......”
苏定安倒吸一口凉气，心中升起强烈的不真实感。
这种好事能落到自己头上？

怕不是诈骗吧？
可转念一想，对方可是本届入门考核唯一的甲等啊！
入门即是镇魔校尉！
这种人物，注定是要一飞冲天的，怎么可能拿他开涮？
“怎么样？实在不行就算了。”陆渊也不想纠结。
“不！”苏定安一拍大腿，语气激动道：“承蒙陆大人看中，苏定安愿意随大人前往赤霞县。”
“不过先说好，我只带路，不动手，真遇到妖魔我就躲得远远的。”
“成交！”
商量妥当，两人走到柜台领取差事。
递交卷宗，老刘诧异地看了一眼苏定安，“哟？老苏，你也去斩妖除魔？”
后者咧嘴一笑，“我可没那能耐，不过是跟在陆大人身边打个杂。”
登记完成，老刘指着苏定安对陆渊说道：“陆大人，这老小子与卑职是八竿子打不着的亲戚，这趟差事，还请您多多费心！”
......
出了司务堂，两人往马场走去。
从镇魔司到赤霞县沿途四百多里，普通马要跑两天半才能到。
但若是换成镇魔司养的追风马，半天足矣。
“陆大人，听说这追风马是以妖魔血脉培养出来的，耐力非凡，跑个一天一夜都不用停歇。”
“就是太贵了，一匹马的价钱够买十匹千里马，普通镇魔卫根本没有用马的资格......”
两人正说着，迎面忽然走来一个身穿墨黑暗纹锦袍的镇魔卫。
腰悬横刀，面色冷峻，正是一直守在外面的周通。

“陆渊，你在入门考核时将林辰打成重伤，至今昏迷不醒，现在，跟我走一趟。”
苏定安脸色微变，一眼就看出了事态不对劲。
他在陆渊耳边低声说道：“陆大人，这是周通，人送外号铁面刀，在册七年的镇魔卫，初境三层。”
苏定安在青州镇魔司待了七年，不止熟悉卷宗案件，对于司内绝大多数镇魔卫也有一定了解。
此刻在旁解释，是为了让陆渊知己知彼，有个准备。
陆渊目光一瞥，毫不客气道：“你算什么东西，也配来主持公道？”
此刻他只想外出斩妖，哪有闲心在这里扯东扯西？
镇魔卫而已，官衔还没他高，竟然一而再，再而三地触他霉头。
他已经不耐烦了，话语之中根本没留面子。
周通闻言怒着一张脸，凶狠的眸子直视陆渊，整个人就像一座即将爆发的火山。
“有种你就把刚才的话再说一遍！”
content_en:
Lu Yuan came to the scribe and placed the file on the counter.
"Excuse me, Secretary Liu, please register. I'll take over the errands in Chixia County."
Lao Liu looked at Lu Yuan expressionlessly and shook his head slightly.
"You're new here? You can't handle this job."
Lu Yuan put his badge on the counter, "I am the Demon-Suppressing Colonel."
Old Liu looked startled, glanced at the badge subconsciously, then bowed with a smile on his face.
"It turns out that Mr. Lu is in person. Please forgive me for being humble and clumsy."
"No problem, just register."
"Master Lu, please forgive me, even if you are a captain, you can't take on this job."
Lu Yuan was stunned. Even the captain of the Demon Suppressing School couldn't answer it?
Old Liu smiled and explained: "According to the rules, the first time a newcomer goes out on a business trip, there must be at least one demon-suppressing guard accompanying him, just in case something goes wrong and no one can tell the truth."
"Master Lu is the Demon Suppressing Captain when he first enters the academy, but after all, he is still a newcomer. This rule cannot be broken."
Lu Yuan frowned slightly. Do you want a demon-suppressing guard to accompany you?
He planned to eat those blood monsters alone from the beginning.
Just as he was thinking about it, he noticed Su Ding'an behind him.
Isn’t there a ready-made one?
"Brother Su, why don't you come with me to Chixia County?"
"Huh? Me?"
Su Ding'an's smile froze for a moment, and he opened his mouth, but no words came out for a long time.
There was a bit of complexity flashing in those bright eyes, there were accidents, surprises, and a bit of guilt.
"That...Master Lu...I..."
Su Ding'an lowered his head and his voice became a little lower.
"If I were killed by a demon, there would be no one to take care of my stupid old mother at home, as well as my frail mother-in-law and my toddler son..."
Lu Yuan opened his mouth, but remained silent.
At this moment, a series of footsteps suddenly came from the side.
"Su Ding'an, I finally found you."
A government servant wearing a jet-black brocade robe leaned halfway in from the door.
"Your mother asked me to give you a message. You are no longer young. If you can't find a wife this year, don't go home during the Chinese New Year."
The air was suddenly quiet.
Su Ding'an's expression was stiff and he stood there at a loss.
Lu Yuan's eyes were playful, "It's not easy for you either. You have a wife and children, but you still have to be forced to get married by your mother?"
"Well..." Su Ding'an forced out a smile that was uglier than crying, "So there is a stupid old mother at home..."
After a long time, he let out a long sigh and buried his head.
"Master Lu...I just...just...are afraid of death."
"Actually, I also want to slay demons, but my qualifications are too poor. I was promoted from a government servant to a demon-suppressing guard only seven years after I started."
"First, I have no ability, and second, I have no courage. Until now, I haven't even mastered a decent martial art."
"It's okay to look through the files and earn some money by relying on my cleverness. If I really encounter a demon, I'm afraid I will be the first to die."
"Forget it, Mr. Lu, thank you for giving me this opportunity. I really don't have the ability."
Lu Yuan nodded, suddenly feeling that Su Ding'an was much more interesting than he thought.
Moreover, Su Ding'an was afraid of death, so he didn't have to worry about the other party's demons snatching him away.
Match successful!
"Follow me. You don't need to kill the demon. You will still receive your merits." Lu Yuan said.
"Ah?" Su Ding'an raised his head suddenly, thinking that he heard wrongly.
No need to kill monsters?
Doesn’t that make him earn his achievements in vain?
The file clearly states that once the blood demon is killed, the organizer will receive 20 merit points and 10 taels of silver, and the co-organizer will receive 10 merit points and 5 taels of silver.
If the blood demon culprit can be captured and brought back to the Demon Suppressing Division, each person can add five points of merit and three taels of silver.
This... is a free gift?
Su Ding'an's mouth felt dry for a while.
Lu Yuan continued: "When we arrive in Chixia County, you will be responsible for leading the way, identifying people, and investigating the specific situation."
"If you really encounter a demon, you should find a safe place and hide away until I finish killing it.Come out again. "
"This..." Su Ding'an couldn't hold back his lips, "Master Lu, are you joking? "
Seeing that Lu Yuan's face was serious and not looking like a joke, he couldn't help but feel a little moved in his heart.
"You really don't need me to do anything? "Su Ding'an asked tentatively.
"No need. "
"Then can I stay away? "
“The further away the better. "
"Hiss..."
Su Ding'an took a deep breath, feeling a strong sense of unreality in his heart.
Can such a good thing happen to me?
I'm afraid it's not a scam, right?
But then I thought about it, the other party was the only first-class person in this entrance examination!
The first step is to become the demon-suppressing captain!
This kind of person is destined to soar to the sky, how can you make fun of him?
"How's it going? If it really doesn’t work, forget it. "Lu Yuan didn't want to get entangled.
"No! "Su Ding'an slapped his thigh and said excitedly: "Thanks to Mr. Lu, Su Ding'an is willing to go to Chixia County with you. "
"But let's make an agreement first. I will only lead the way and not take action. If I encounter a monster, I will stay far away. "
"make a deal! "
After discussing it, the two walked to the counter to receive their errands.
After handing over the dossier, Old Liu glanced at Su Ding'an in surprise, "Yo? Old Su, are you going to slay demons too? "
The latter grinned, "I don't have that ability, I'm just doing odd jobs with Mr. Lu. "
After the registration was completed, Lao Liu pointed at Su Ding'an and said to Lu Yuan: "Master Lu, this old boy and the humble position are inseparable relatives. Please take care of this errand!" "
...
After leaving the Siwu Hall, the two walked towards the racecourse.
The journey from Zhenmosi to Chixia County is more than 400 miles, and it would take an ordinary horse two and a half days to get there.
But if it were replaced by the wind-chasing horse raised by the Demon Suppressing Division, half a day would be enough.
"Master Lu, I heard that this wind-chasing horse was bred with the blood of demons. It has extraordinary endurance and can run all day and all night without stopping. "
"It's just too expensive. The price of one horse is enough to buy ten thousand-mile horses. Ordinary demon-suppressing guards have no qualifications to use horses..."
While the two were talking, a demon-suppressing guard wearing a dark brocade robe suddenly walked towards them.
With a sword hanging from his waist and a stern face, it was Zhou Tong who had been guarding outside.
"Lu Yuan, you severely injured Lin Chen during the entrance examination and he is still unconscious. Now, come with me. "
Su Ding'an's face changed slightly, and he could tell at a glance that something was wrong.
He whispered in Lu Yuan's ear: "Master Lu, this is Zhou Tong, nicknamed Iron-faced Sword, a demon-suppressing guard who has been on the list for seven years, and is in the third level of the first level. "
Su Dingan has been in the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division for seven years. He is not only familiar with the case files, but also has a certain understanding of most of the Demon Suppression Guards in the division.
The purpose of explaining this moment was to let Lu Yuan know himself and his enemy and be prepared.
Lu Yuan glanced at him and said unceremoniously: "Who do you think you are, worthy of upholding justice? "
At this moment, he just wants to go out and slay demons, so how can he have the time to talk nonsense here?
He was just a demon-suppressing guard, and his official rank was not as high as his, but he got into trouble again and again.
He was already impatient and didn't save face at all in his words.
Zhou Tong had an angry face when he heard this, and looked directly at Lu Yuan with fierce eyes, his whole person was like a volcano about to erupt.
"If you dare, just say what you just said again! "
